newsitem.title: USA: Signal to close Tenn. plant with 260 workers.
newsitem.headline: Signal to close Tenn. plant with 260 workers.

text.p: Signal Apparel Co Inc said Thursday that it may close its Tazewell, Tenn., plant in a move to scale back its domestic manufacturing capacity and expand its global sourcing.
The company also said it is exploring different alternatives to closing the facility, including scaling back production and producing garments on a contract basis.

But it added that if these two alternatives were not feasible, it would close the plant in early September. It has already notified the plant's 260 employees and it said it is working closely with them to ease the transition.
Signal said it is taking these steps to increase its emphasis on higher-margin screenprinted activewear and move away from manufacturing low-margin undecorated activewear.
The company added that it has initiated a search for a manager to head its enhanced sourcing operations.
Signal makes and sells activewear in juvenile, youth and adult sizes.
